say: Your goal is to wire its control board to make it reach the ring ahead.
**Objectives** are what the level asks. Here, get into the ring before the 10 s are out.
The window has two tabs: Run plays the level, and on the **Board** you build its control board.
Click the **Board** tab or button, or press Tab.
The nav bar opens the drawers: **Tools**, **Parts**, **Files**, **Diagnostic**, **Navigator**. At its foot: **Hints**, **Settings**, **Chapters**, and **Run**.
A **Source** sends beads all the time; a thruster pushes as hard as beads come in.
Click the **Source**, then the **Thruster** to wire them.
Click the **Run** tab or button, or press **Tab**.
Press **Play**, or Space to play the simulation.
You won! You reached the objectives.
If you are stuck, try clicking **Hints**.
